name: World Studio
description: In-game creative world editor inspired by Roblox Studio. Select a region with the Studio Wand, then fill, replace, hollow, outline or clear it from a graphical panel with a searchable block palette. Copy structures to a clipboard, rotate them in 90 degree steps, paste with a live preview, undo/redo any edit, and save or load builds from a schematic library stored in your world folder.
